hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Southern Asia, north and west of Pakistan, east of Iran || mostly rugged mountains; plains in north and southwest || landlocked; the Hindu Kush mountains that run northeast to southwest divide the northern provinces from the rest of the country; the highest peaks are in the northern Vakhan (Wakhan Corridor) || Resources: natural gas, petroleum, coal, copper, chromite, talc, barites, sulfur, lead, zinc, iron ore, salt, precious and semiprecious stones, arable land || Exports: coal, grapes, tropical fruits, gum resins, other nuts (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mostly rugged mountains; plains in north and southwest || Southern Asia, north and west of Pakistan, east of Iran

climate.excerpt: arid to semiarid; cold winters and hot summers || damaging earthquakes occur in Hindu Kush mountains; flooding; droughts

economy.excerpt: low-income South Asian economy; economy stable after major contraction due to Taliban takeover, but recovery remains fragile; widespread poverty and obstacles to human development; import-reliant for food, fuel, and machinery; ongoing sanctions, suspended development aid, and frozen reserve assets || Exports: coal, grapes, tropical fruits, gum resins, other nuts (2023) || Industries: small-scale production of bricks, textiles, soap, furniture, shoes, fertilizer, apparel, food products, non-alcoholic beverages, mineral water, cement; handwoven carpets; natural gas, coal, copper

peopleAndCulture.from: People and Society > Languages, Religions, Ethnic groups, Urbanization
peopleAndCulture.excerpt: Muslim 99.7% (Sunni 84.7 - 89.7%, Shia 10 - 15%), other <0.3% (2009 est.) || current, reliable statistical data on ethnicity in Afghanistan are not available; Afghanistan's 2004 Constitution cited Pashtun, Tajik, Hazara, Uzbek, Turkman, Baluch, Pashaie, Nuristani, Aymaq, Arab, Qirghiz, Qizilbash, Gujur, and Brahwui ethnicities; Afghanistan has dozens of other small ethnic groups
